column2: Telegram aggiunge ai link di alcuni dei suoi siti web un token di accesso per il tuo account. Con questa opzione attiva, quei link si aprono senza token e puoi accedere tu stesso.

opened link tracking
shared link tracking

website sign-in tokens
column2: i token di accesso ai siti web

column1: Stops usage reports to Telegram, like how long you read each channel post and what you tap on Premium screens. Messages and calls work as before.
column2: Interrompe i report di utilizzo a Telegram, come quanto tempo leggi ogni post di un canale e cosa tocchi nelle schermate Premium. Messaggi e chiamate funzionano come prima.

column1: Premium promo views
Premium promo taps
Premium promo accepts
Premium promo failures
dual camera reports
# context: Privacy page switch title under Stop usage reports. When on, Telegram isn't told that you read a chat or watched a story.
Ghost mode
# context: Summary under that switch. Sending a message tells Telegram the chat was read anyway, and the account's other devices never learn it was read.
Read chats and watch stories without anyone being told. Sending a message in a chat still marks it read, and your other devices keep showing it unread.
column2: Leggi le chat e guarda le storie senza che nessuno lo venga a sapere. Se invii un messaggio in una chat, questa viene comunque segnata come letta e i tuoi altri dispositivi continuano a mostrarla come non letta.

column1: # context: Switch title under Ghost mode. Read receipts are the ticks that tell a sender their message was read.
No read receipts
# context: Summary under that switch. A voice message stays marked unplayed for its sender until it's played.
Messages you read stay unread for the people who sent them, in private chats, groups and secret chats, and voice messages you play stay unplayed. Works with Ghost mode on.
column2: I messaggi che leggi restano non letti per chi li ha inviati, nelle chat private, nei gruppi e nelle chat segrete, e i messaggi vocali che riproduci restano non ascoltati. Funziona con la Modalità fantasma attiva.

column1: # context: Switch title under Ghost mode. When on, watching someone's story doesn't put you on its viewer list.
View stories anonymously
column2: Guarda le storie in modo anonimo

column1: Stories you watch don't add you to their viewer list. Works with Ghost mode on.
column2: Le storie che guardi non ti aggiungono al loro elenco degli spettatori. Funziona con la Modalità fantasma attiva.

column1: # context: Switch title under Ghost mode. When on, the chat doesn't show the other person that you're typing, recording or uploading.
Hide typing
# context: Summary under that switch. Covers the typing, voice recording, video and file uploading statuses shown at the top of a chat.
Other people don't see that you're typing, recording or sending a file. Works with Ghost mode on.
column2: Gli altri non vedono che stai digitando, registrando o inviando un file. Funziona con la Modalità fantasma attiva.

column1: # context: Switch title under Ghost mode. When on, Telegram isn't told the account is online, so Last seen doesn't update while you use the app.
Hide online status
# context: Summary under that switch. Telegram is still told when the app goes offline, so the account shows as offline.
Telegram isn't told that you're online while you use it. Going offline still goes out. Works with Ghost mode on.
column2: Telegram non viene informato che sei online mentre lo usi. Il passaggio a offline viene comunque comunicato. Funziona con la Modalità fantasma attiva.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase naming the part of Stop usage reports that Ghost mode covers, listed in coverage lines with "channel read metrics" and "dual camera reports".
read receipts and story views
column2: conferme di lettura e visualizzazioni delle storie

column1: Accounts
Every switch here applies to all the accounts in this Telegram app, not only the one you have open.
column2: Ogni interruttore qui si applica a tutti gli account in questa app Telegram, non solo a quello che hai aperto.

column1: No previews before sending
Telegram doesn't look up link previews for messages you haven't sent yet, including shares, polls, story links and bots. Sent messages still get one.
column2: Telegram non cerca le anteprime dei link per i messaggi che non hai ancora inviato, inclusi condivisioni, sondaggi, link di storie e bot. I messaggi inviati ne ricevono comunque una.

column1: # context: Privacy page switch title. When on, an unsent message stays only on this phone instead of syncing to the account's other devices.
Keep drafts on this phone
column2: Mantieni le bozze su questo telefono

column1: # context: Summary under that switch. Clearing a draft (emptying the text box) is still sent so other devices drop it too.
A message you start but don't send stays on this phone and stops syncing to your other devices. Clearing a draft still clears it there.
column2: Un messaggio che inizi ma non invii resta su questo telefono e smette di sincronizzarsi con gli altri tuoi dispositivi. Cancellare una bozza la cancella comunque anche lì.

column1: # context: Privacy page switch title. When on, text typed in Telegram's main search is no longer sent to Telegram's server, except in its Posts tab. Search inside a chat still is.
Keep searches on this phone
column2: Mantieni le ricerche su questo telefono

column1: # context: Summary under that switch. Chats, Channels, Apps and Posts are tabs in Telegram's search, and the media tabs are Media, Links, Files, Music and Voice, so use Telegram's own words for those tabs in your language. Public accounts means people, bots and channels found by username.

What you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram, except in the Posts tab. The Chats tab finds your chats and contacts on this phone, plus recent searches, but not messages or public accounts. Channels, Apps, the media tabs and chat or date filters don't search for typed text. Search inside a chat still goes to Telegram.
column2: Ciò che digiti nella ricerca principale non viene inviato a Telegram, tranne nella scheda Post. La scheda Chat trova le tue chat e i tuoi contatti su questo telefono, oltre alle ricerche recenti, ma non i messaggi o gli account pubblici. Canali, App, le schede Media, Link, File, Musica e Voce e i filtri per chat o data non cercano il testo digitato. La ricerca all'interno di una chat va comunque a Telegram.

column1: # context: Extra line under Telegram's "No results" message in the Chats tab of search, shown while Keep searches on this phone is on. It explains why nothing from Telegram's server turned up.
Only chats and contacts on this phone were searched.
column2: Sono state cercate solo le chat e i contatti su questo telefono.

column1: Draft link previews
chat drafts
share sheet comments
poll links
story links
bot shares

draft syncing

search lookups
Camera only on tap
Opening the attachment gallery doesn't start the camera or ask for camera access. Tap the camera tile to start it.
column2: Aprire la galleria allegati non avvia la fotocamera né chiede l'accesso alla fotocamera. Tocca il riquadro della fotocamera per avviarla.

column1: Gallery camera
No swipe actions on chats
column2: Nessuna azione di scorrimento sulle chat

column1: Swiping a chat in your list no longer archives, mutes, pins, deletes or marks it read. Press and hold still offers every action.
column2: Scorrere su una chat nell'elenco non la archivia più, non la silenzia, non la fissa, non la elimina né la segna come letta. Tenere premuto offre ancora tutte le azioni.

column1: Hide popular apps
Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search, and doesn't ask Telegram for it. Apps you've opened and other results stay.
column2: Nasconde l'elenco App popolari nella scheda App della ricerca e non lo richiede a Telegram. Le app che hai aperto e gli altri risultati restano.

column1: Hide contacts on Telegram
When your chat list is short, Telegram lists your contacts below it. This hides that list and its heading. Chats, folders and search stay.
column2: Quando la lista chat è breve, Telegram mostra i tuoi contatti sotto di essa. Questa opzione nasconde quell'elenco e il suo titolo. Chat, cartelle e ricerca restano.

column1: Hide greeting stickers
Empty private chats stop suggesting a sticker to say hello. Their other text and notices, and the sticker picker, stay.
column2: Le chat private vuote smettono di suggerire uno sticker per salutare. Gli altri testi e avvisi, e il selettore di sticker, restano.

column1: Quiet contacts prompts
After you say no to contacts access, the Contacts tab stops asking again and its warning badge goes away.
column2: Dopo aver negato l'accesso ai contatti, la scheda Contatti smette di chiedere di nuovo e il suo indicatore di avviso scompare.

column1: New Year look all year

Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not only around New Year. Snow falls on the chat list's top bar and on chat backgrounds once Wallpaper rotation is on under Power Saving, in Effects in Chats.
column2: Mostra il cappello di Babbo Natale di Telegram e la neve di Capodanno tutto l'anno, non solo nel periodo di Capodanno. La neve cade sulla barra superiore della lista chat e sugli sfondi delle chat quando Rotazione dello sfondo è attiva in Risparmio energetico, in Effetti nelle chat.

column1: # context: Look and feel page row title, and the title of its editor dialog. The person picks an emoji or a few letters shown after Telegram's name (its logo) at the top of the chat list.
Emoji next to the chat list title
column2: Emoji accanto al titolo della lista chat

column1: # context: Summary under that row while nothing is set. Premium emoji status is Telegram's own paid status emoji next to the name, which this doesn't change.
Add an emoji or a few letters after Telegram's name at the top of the chat list. It stays on this phone, and your Premium emoji status is left alone.
column2: Aggiungi un'emoji o qualche lettera dopo il nome di Telegram in cima alla lista chat. Resta su questo telefono e il tuo stato emoji Premium non cambia.

column1: # context: Summary under that row once something is set. %1$s is the emoji or letters the person saved.
%1$s shows after Telegram's name at the top of the chat list, on this phone only. Tap to change it.
column2: %1$s appare dopo il nome di Telegram in cima alla lista chat, solo su questo telefono. Tocca per cambiarlo.

none

Emoji or a few letters
# context: Instructions at the top of the editor dialog.

Shown after Telegram's name at the top of the chat list. It stays on this phone, so nothing goes to Telegram and your Premium emoji status is left alone. Leave it empty to show nothing, and restart Telegram to see a change.
column2: Compare dopo il nome di Telegram in cima alla lista chat. Resta su questo telefono, quindi nulla va a Telegram e il tuo stato emoji Premium non cambia. Lascialo vuoto per non mostrare nulla e riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: # context: Error under the field and toast when the text is too long to save. Keep it under about 64 characters.
That's too long. Try an emoji or two, or a short word.
column2: È troppo lungo. Prova con una o due emoji o una parola corta.

column1: # context: Error under the field and toast when saving failed. Keep it under about 64 characters.
Couldn't save the emoji. Try again in a moment.
column2: Impossibile salvare l'emoji. Riprova tra poco.

column1: # context: Short toast after the editor saved text that needs no restart, such as clearing it again before restarting.
Saved.
# context: Sentence in the settings import preview when the imported file changes that text.
The emoji next to the chat list title will change.
column2: L'emoji accanto al titolo della lista chat cambierà.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Holiday look all year that draws the emoji after the chat list title.
emoji next to the chat list title
column2: l'emoji accanto al titolo della lista chat

column1: # context: Look and feel page switch title, below Emoji next to the chat list title. When on, the person's own text takes the place of Telegram's name (its logo) at the top of the chat list.
Your own chat list title
column2: Titolo personalizzato per la lista chat

column1: # context: Summary under the Your own chat list title switch. The text is drawn in the title's own bold font and theme color.
Shows text of your choice in place of Telegram's name at the top of the chat list, in the title's own font and color. It stays on this phone. Restart Telegram to see the change.
column2: Mostra un testo a tua scelta al posto del nome di Telegram in cima alla lista chat, con il carattere e il colore del titolo. Resta su questo telefono. Riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: # context: Look and feel page row title below the Your own chat list title switch, the title of its editor dialog, and a label in the settings import preview line "%1$s: %2$s to %3$s".
Text for the chat list title
column2: Testo per il titolo della lista chat

column1: # context: Summary under the Text for the chat list title row while nothing is saved. Your own chat list title is the switch above it.
Type what shows in place of Telegram's name while Your own chat list title is on. Empty keeps Telegram's name.
column2: Scrivi cosa mostrare al posto del nome di Telegram mentre Titolo personalizzato per la lista chat è attivo. Se lo lasci vuoto, resta il nome di Telegram.

column1: # context: Summary under the Text for the chat list title row once something is saved. %1$s is the text the person saved. Your own chat list title is the switch above it.
%1$s shows in place of Telegram's name while Your own chat list title is on. Tap to change it.
column2: %1$s appare al posto del nome di Telegram mentre Titolo personalizzato per la lista chat è attivo. Tocca per cambiarlo.

column1: # context: Label and hint of the one text field in the Text for the chat list title editor dialog.
A short name
# context: Instructions at the top of the Text for the chat list title editor dialog. Your own chat list title is the switch on the same page.

Shown in place of Telegram's name at the top of the chat list while Your own chat list title is on, in the title's own font and color. It stays on this phone, so nothing goes to Telegram. Leave it empty to keep Telegram's name, and restart Telegram to see a change.
column2: Compare al posto del nome di Telegram in cima alla lista chat mentre Titolo personalizzato per la lista chat è attivo, con il carattere e il colore del titolo. Resta su questo telefono, quindi nulla va a Telegram. Lascialo vuoto per mantenere il nome di Telegram e riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: # context: Error under the field and toast when the chat list title text is too long to save. Must fit two short toast lines.
That's too long. Try a shorter name.
column2: È troppo lungo. Prova con un nome più breve.

Couldn't save the title. Try again in a moment.
column2: Impossibile salvare il titolo. Riprova tra poco.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of New Year look all year that puts the person's own text in place of Telegram's name at the top of the chat list.
your own chat list title
column2: il titolo personalizzato per la lista chat

column1: Use system font
Bold, italic and code text use your phone's font instead of Telegram's built-in one. Restart Telegram to see the change.
column2: Il testo in grassetto, corsivo e codice usa il carattere del telefono invece di quello integrato di Telegram. Riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: AMOLED black
Night and Dark themes use pure black screens. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. Restart Telegram to see the change.
column2: I temi Notte e Scuro usano schermi neri puri. Le bolle dei messaggi e i menu mantengono i loro colori. Riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: Hide translate bar
Chats in another language stop showing the translate bar at the top. Translate moves to the chat's menu, and a chat you're translating keeps its bar.
column2: Le chat in un'altra lingua non mostrano più la barra di traduzione in alto. Traduci si sposta nel menu della chat, e una chat che stai traducendo mantiene la sua barra.

column1: # context: Conversations page switch title, below Hide translate bar. It hides the bar under a chat's top bar that shows the pinned message (Telegram's PinnedMessage strings).
Hide pinned message bar
# context: Summary under the Hide pinned message bar switch. The counter is the multi-pin indicator and the list button opens all pinned messages.
The bar under a chat's top bar that shows pinned messages is gone, along with its counter and list button. Messages stay pinned and nothing is marked as read.
column2: La barra sotto la barra superiore della chat che mostra i messaggi fissati scompare, insieme al contatore e al pulsante dell'elenco. I messaggi rimangono fissati e nulla viene segnato come letto.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Hide translate bar that hides the pinned message bar in chats.
pinned message bar in chats
column2: la barra dei messaggi fissati nelle chat

column1: # context: Conversations page switch title, below Hide pinned message bar. It puts the translate bar at the top of every chat, including chats where Telegram doesn't detect another language.
Always show translate bar
column2: Mostra sempre la barra di traduzione

column1: # context: Summary under the Always show translate bar switch. Premium is Telegram Premium, the outside translation service is the Translate with an outside service switch, and Hide translate bar is the switch of that name, which overrules this one.
Every chat gets the translate bar, even when Telegram doesn't spot another language. It needs Premium or an outside translation service, and Hide translate bar wins.
column2: Ogni chat mostra la barra di traduzione, anche quando Telegram non rileva un'altra lingua. Serve Premium o un servizio di traduzione esterno, e Nascondi barra di traduzione ha la precedenza.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Hide translate bar that shows the translate bar in every chat.
translate bar in every chat
column2: la barra di traduzione in ogni chat

column1: Exact numbers
Member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts show in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K.
column2: I conteggi di membri, iscritti, visualizzazioni, risposte e reazioni si mostrano completi, come 12.345 invece di 12,3K.

column1: Reveal spoilers
Spoiler text, photos and videos show right away without a tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered.
column2: Il testo, le foto e i video con spoiler si mostrano subito senza toccare. I media a visualizzazione singola, i contenuti sensibili e i codici di accesso restano coperti.

column1: Hide keyboard on scroll
The keyboard closes when you start scrolling a chat. The emoji and sticker panel stays open.
column2: La tastiera si chiude quando inizi a scorrere in una chat. Il pannello di emoji e sticker resta aperto.

column1: Keep videos muted on volume keys
column2: Mantieni i video muti con i tasti del volume

column1: Volume keys only change the volume. They no longer start the video or round video on screen with sound. Tap a video to hear it.
column2: I tasti del volume cambiano solo il volume. Non avviano più il video o il video rotondo sullo schermo con l'audio. Tocca un video per ascoltarlo.

column1: # context: a second switch under Keep videos muted on volume keys (#27). Telegram turns a video put in full screen to one fixed landscape side; with this on it follows the phone to either side.
Full screen videos turn either way
column2: I video a schermo intero ruotano da entrambi i lati

column1: # context: that switch's summary. "full screen" is Telegram's full screen button on a video; "auto-rotate" is Android's own screen rotation setting, use the phone's name for it.
After you tap full screen, a video follows your phone to either landscape side, even with auto-rotate off. Turning your phone upright doesn't end full screen. Tap the button to leave it.
column2: Dopo che tocchi schermo intero, un video segue il telefono su entrambi i lati in orizzontale, anche con la rotazione automatica disattivata. Girare il telefono in verticale non fa uscire dalla schermata intera. Tocca il pulsante per uscirne.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Keep videos muted on volume keys that lets a full screen video turn to either landscape side.
full screen video turning either way
column2: la rotazione del video a schermo intero in entrambi i lati

column1: # context: a third switch under Keep videos muted on volume keys (#27). With it on, an open video in the viewer stays in portrait when the phone is turned, and goes landscape only from Telegram's full screen button.
Turn videos only from the full screen button
column2: Ruota i video solo con il pulsante a schermo intero

column1: # context: that switch's summary. "full screen" is Telegram's full screen button on a video; use the phone's own words for turning the phone.
An open video stays upright when you turn your phone. It goes landscape only when you tap full screen, and back only when you tap the button again.
column2: Un video aperto resta in verticale quando ruoti il telefono. Passa in orizzontale solo quando tocchi il pulsante a schermo intero, e torna in verticale solo quando lo tocchi di nuovo.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Keep videos muted on volume keys that keeps an open video upright until full screen.
keeping a video upright until full screen
column2: mantenere un video in verticale fino allo schermo intero

column1: Swipe back on profiles
Swiping right on a profile's photos or media tabs goes back, like the rest of the profile, instead of showing the previous photo or tab.
column2: Scorrendo verso destra sulle schede foto o media di un profilo si torna indietro, come nel resto del profilo, invece di mostrare la foto o la scheda precedente.

column1: Hide phone number
Your own phone number shows as dots in Settings and your profile, which helps with screenshots. Others' numbers stay visible.
column2: Il tuo numero di telefono appare come puntini in Impostazioni e nel tuo profilo, il che aiuta con gli screenshot. I numeri degli altri restano visibili.

column1: # context: Privacy page switch title, under Hide phone number. When on, the box on Telegram's add contact screen that shares your own phone number with the new contact starts unticked.
Don't share my number by default
column2: Non condividere il mio numero di default

column1: # context: Summary under that switch. The box is Telegram's own checkbox on the add contact screen, and the person can still tick it.
When you add someone as a contact from their chat, Telegram ticks the box that shares your phone number with them. With this on, the box starts clear and your number goes only if you tick it.
column2: Quando aggiungi qualcuno come contatto dalla sua chat, Telegram spunta la casella che condivide il tuo numero di telefono con quella persona. Con questa opzione attiva, la casella parte vuota e il tuo numero viene condiviso solo se la spunti.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Hide phone number that starts the add contact screen's share box unticked.
number sharing on new contacts
column2: la condivisione del numero con i nuovi contatti

column1: Message times with seconds
column2: Orari dei messaggi con i secondi

column1: Each message's time includes seconds, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart.
column2: L'ora di ogni messaggio include i secondi, ad esempio 21:41:27, così i messaggi inviati a breve distanza sono facili da distinguere.

column1: Allow chat blur on slower phones
column2: Consenti la sfocatura delle chat sui telefoni più lenti

column1: Telegram only blurs chat headers and panels on fast phones. This lets any phone do it, once Blur in chat is on under Power saving.
column2: Telegram sfoca le intestazioni e i pannelli delle chat solo sui telefoni veloci. Questa opzione permette a qualsiasi telefono di farlo, quando Sfocatura nelle chat è attiva in Risparmio energetico.

column1: Play voice messages one at a time
column2: Riproduci i messaggi vocali uno alla volta

column1: When a voice or video message ends, the next one doesn't start by itself.
column2: Quando termina un messaggio vocale o video, il successivo non parte da solo.

column1: # context: Playback page switch title, under Play voice messages one at a time and independent of it. When on, voice and round video messages can't be started while the phone's lock screen shows.
Keep voice messages quiet while locked
column2: Silenzia i messaggi vocali con telefono bloccato

column1: # context: Summary under that switch. Round video messages are Telegram's circular video notes; the notification is Telegram's music player notification.

While your phone is locked, voice and round video messages don't start, resume or skip to the next one, whether from headphones, a car, the notification or the lock screen. One that's already playing finishes. Music and other videos play as usual.
column2: Mentre il telefono è bloccato, i messaggi vocali e i messaggi video circolari non si avviano, non riprendono e non passano al successivo, che arrivino da auricolari, auto, notifica o schermata di blocco. Quello già in riproduzione termina. La musica e gli altri video vengono riprodotti come al solito.

column1: # context: Short toast when a voice or round video message was asked to play while the phone is locked and the switch is on.
Unlock your phone to play voice and video messages.
column2: Sblocca il telefono per riprodurre i messaggi vocali e video.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the locked phone part of Play voice messages one at a time.
voice playback while locked
Stop vibrations on taps
Taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries no longer vibrate the phone. Incoming calls still vibrate, and notifications follow your own settings.
column2: Tocchi, pressioni prolungate, scorrimenti e inserimenti errati non fanno più vibrare il telefono. Le chiamate in arrivo vibrano ancora e le notifiche seguono le tue impostazioni.

column1: Turn off reaction effects
When someone reacts to a message, the emoji doesn't fly across the screen and burst. The reaction still shows on the message.
column2: Quando qualcuno reagisce a un messaggio, l'emoji non attraversa lo schermo e non esplode. La reazione viene comunque mostrata sul messaggio.

column1: Hide folder tab counters
column2: Nascondi i contatori delle schede delle cartelle

column1: Folder tabs above the chat list show just their names, without unread counts. Chats stay unread and the app icon badge doesn't change.
column2: Le schede delle cartelle sopra la lista chat mostrano solo i loro nomi, senza conteggi di non letti. Le chat restano non lette e il badge dell'icona dell'app non cambia.

column1: Hide sender names when forwarding
column2: Nascondi i nomi dei mittenti durante l'inoltro

column1: Each new forward starts with Hide sender's name turned on, so copies arrive without the original author, even when you pick several chats at once. You can still turn it off in the forward preview, or by holding the send button in the Share sheet. Forwards to Saved Messages keep the sender.
column2: Ogni nuovo inoltro parte con l'opzione Nascondi nome del mittente attiva, così le copie arrivano senza l'autore originale, anche quando scegli più chat alla volta. Puoi comunque disattivarlo nell'anteprima dell'inoltro o tenendo premuto il pulsante di invio nel foglio di condivisione. Gli inoltri ai Messaggi salvati mantengono il mittente.

column1: Voice messages in the music player
While a voice message plays, tapping the bar above the chat opens the full music player, where you can drag to skip around, instead of jumping to the message.
column2: Mentre viene riprodotto un messaggio vocale, toccando la barra sopra la chat si apre il lettore musicale completo, dove puoi trascinare per spostarti avanti e indietro, invece di saltare al messaggio.

column1: Silence people outside your contacts
column2: Silenzia chi non è tra i tuoi contatti

column1: Private messages from people not in your contacts still show a notification, but without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound.
column2: I messaggi privati delle persone che non sono tra i tuoi contatti mostrano comunque una notifica, ma senza suono o vibrazione. Bot, promemoria e codici di accesso mantengono il loro suono.

column1: Disable pull to archive
Pulling down the chat list no longer opens the archive. Use Archived chats in the list's menu instead. Restart Telegram to see the change.
column2: Trascinando verso il basso la lista chat non si apre più l'archivio. Usa invece Chat archiviate nel menu della lista. Riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: Start the camera on the rear lens
column2: Avvia la fotocamera con l'obiettivo posteriore

column1: The camera in the attachment menu always opens on the rear lens, not the lens you used last. You can still flip it.
column2: La fotocamera nel menu degli allegati si apre sempre con la lente posteriore, non con quella usata l'ultima volta. Puoi comunque cambiarla.

column1: Hide gallery camera tile
column2: Nascondi il riquadro della fotocamera nella galleria

column1: The attachment menu's photo grid starts with your photos instead of a live camera tile. A chat picks this up the next time you open it.
column2: La griglia di foto del menu degli allegati inizia con le tue foto invece di un riquadro della fotocamera in tempo reale. Una chat applica questa modifica la prossima volta che la apri.

column1: Hide time on stickers
Stickers and big animated emoji no longer show the time and read checks in their corner. Other messages keep their time.
column2: Gli sticker e le grandi emoji animate non mostrano più l'ora e le spunte di lettura nell'angolo. Gli altri messaggi mantengono la loro ora.

column1: Ignore mentions in muted chats
column2: Ignora le menzioni nelle chat silenziate

column1: Mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted no longer notify you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before.
column2: Le menzioni e le risposte nei gruppi o canali che hai silenziato non ti inviano più notifiche. Le chat che non hai silenziato ti inviano notifiche come prima.

column1: Hide blocked users in groups
column2: Nascondi gli utenti bloccati nei gruppi

column1: Messages from people you've blocked are left out of groups and supergroups you open, and don't notify you. Nothing is deleted. Private chats and channel posts stay as they are.
column2: I messaggi delle persone che hai bloccato vengono esclusi dai gruppi e supergruppi che apri e non ti inviano notifiche. Non viene eliminato nulla. Le chat private e i post dei canali restano come sono.

column1: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
column2: Nascondi Funzioni di Telegram e Invita amici

column1: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and Invite Friends from Contacts. With no contacts yet, the invite list goes too.
column2: Rimuove la riga Funzioni di Telegram dalle Impostazioni e Invita amici dai Contatti. Se non hai ancora contatti, scompare anche l'elenco degli inviti.

column1: Keep deleted messages
Messages others delete stay in your chat on this phone, marked deleted next to the time. Your own deletes and disappearing messages work as usual.
column2: I messaggi che gli altri eliminano restano nella chat su questo telefono, contrassegnati come eliminati accanto all'ora. Le tue eliminazioni e i messaggi che scompaiono funzionano come al solito.

Keep the Keep-Alive Service running

Android stops Telegram's Keep-Alive Service soon after you leave the app, so messages wait until you open it again. With this on, the service shows a quiet notification and keeps running. It only does something while Keep-Alive Service is on in Telegram's own Settings > Notifications, under Other.

Hide channel Mute button
column2: Nascondi il pulsante Silenzia del canale

The bar at the bottom of a channel you've joined goes away, along with its Mute button and the Search and Info buttons beside it. Channels you haven't joined still show Join. To mute a channel, open its info. A channel picks this up the next time you open it.
column2: La barra in fondo a un canale a cui ti sei unito scompare, insieme al suo pulsante Silenzia e ai pulsanti Cerca e Informazioni accanto. I canali a cui non ti sei unito mostrano ancora Unisciti. Per silenziare un canale, apri le sue informazioni. Un canale lo applica la prossima volta che lo apri.

Mute button on the channel bar
column2: pulsante Silenzia della barra del canale

Hide channel share button
column2: Nascondi il pulsante Condividi dei canali

column1: # context: that switch's summary. Saved Messages is Telegram's own name for the chat with yourself (key SavedMessages); use its applied translation.

The round share button beside channel posts goes away, in the channel and wherever a post is forwarded. A post's own menu still forwards it. Bots and Saved Messages keep theirs. A chat picks this up the next time you open it.
column2: Il pulsante rotondo Condividi accanto ai post dei canali scompare, nel canale e ovunque un post venga inoltrato. Il menu del post permette comunque di inoltrarlo. Bot e Messaggi salvati mantengono il loro. Una chat lo applica la prossima volta che la apri.

column1: Hide Send as button

Your picture next to the message box goes away in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Once you pick a channel it shows again, so you can always see who you're posting as. To pick one, turn this off first. A chat picks this up the next time you open it.
column2: La tua foto accanto al campo del messaggio scompare nei gruppi e nei canali dove potresti pubblicare come canale, mentre pubblichi come te stesso. Quando scegli un canale, riappare, così puoi sempre vedere per conto di chi pubblichi. Per sceglierne uno, disattiva prima questa opzione. Una chat lo applica la prossima volta che la apri.

column1: # context: Hide Contacts tab. Contacts, Calls and Settings are Telegram's own names for the tabs in the bar at the bottom of the main screen; the new message button is the round pencil button on the chat list.
Hide Contacts tab

The Contacts tab leaves the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. Restart Telegram to see the change.
column2: La scheda Contatti sparisce dalla barra in fondo alla schermata principale e anche scorrere non apre più la sua pagina. La scheda Chiamate o Impostazioni resta come in Telegram, e il pulsante di nuovo messaggio della lista chat continua ad aprire i tuoi contatti. Riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: # context: Chat list page switch title, under Hide Contacts tab and independent of it. When on, the bar at the bottom of the main screen (Chats, Contacts, Calls or Settings, Profile) is drawn shorter and narrower.
Compact bottom bar
# context: Summary under that switch. The tabs are the buttons in that bar; they keep their height so they stay as easy to tap.
The bar at the bottom of the main screen gets shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. The tabs keep their full height, so they're just as easy to tap. Restart Telegram to see the change.
column2: La barra in fondo alla schermata principale diventa più bassa e larga solo quanto serve alle sue schede. Le schede mantengono tutta la loro altezza, quindi restano facili da toccare. Riavvia Telegram per vedere la modifica.

column1: # context: Chat list page switch title, under Hide Contacts tab. When on, swiping right on the first chat folder slides in a menu from the left edge, like the navigation drawer older Telegram versions had.
Side menu

# context: Summary under that switch. The list names the menu's rows: My Profile, New Message, Contacts, Calls, Saved Messages, Settings, and an account switcher. Back is the phone's back gesture or button.

Swipe right on your first chat folder and a menu slides in, like the one older Telegram had. It has your profile, new message, contacts, calls, saved messages and settings, plus a way to switch accounts. Back or a tap beside it closes it.
column2: Scorri verso destra sulla tua prima cartella di chat e appare un menu laterale, come quello del vecchio Telegram. Contiene il tuo profilo, nuovo messaggio, contatti, chiamate, Messaggi salvati e impostazioni, più un modo per cambiare account. Il tasto indietro o un tocco accanto lo chiude.

Hide messages by keyword

Messages in groups and channels that match one of your filters are left out when you open the chat. Private chats and your own messages stay as they are. Nothing is deleted, and your filters stay on this phone.

Change sticker size
Stickers in chats show at the size you pick below. Animated emoji and dice keep Telegram's size. A chat picks this up the next time you open it.

Faster downloads

Files download in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram goes back to small ones. The next download picks this up.
column2: I file vengono scaricati in blocchi da 512 KB, 8 alla volta, invece di blocchi da 128 KB, 4 alla volta. Se un blocco grande fallisce, Telegram torna a quelli piccoli. Il download successivo applica questa modifica.

column1: # context: a switch on the Notifications page. UnifiedPush is the name of an open notification standard and stays as it is.
UnifiedPush notifications
# context: that switch's summary. Firebase is Google's notification service and ntfy is an app; both names stay as they are.

For phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram signs up an address from a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, and Telegram's servers call it to wake Telegram when something arrives. The messages still come from Telegram itself. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself. Turned off, Telegram goes back to Firebase the next time it starts.
column2: Per i telefoni in cui le notifiche Firebase non arrivano. Telegram registra un indirizzo da un'app UnifiedPush come ntfy e i server di Telegram lo chiamano per svegliare Telegram quando arriva qualcosa. I messaggi continuano ad arrivare da Telegram stesso. Attiva anche il Servizio keep-alive di Telegram e la Connessione in background, a meno che tu non abbia già impostato tu stesso una delle due. Se disattivato, Telegram torna a Firebase al prossimo avvio.

%1$s gave an address without https, which Telegram's servers won't call.

The server behind %1$s is down for now. Wake-ups come back once it's up.
column2: Il server di %1$s non è al momento disponibile. I risvegli riprenderanno quando sarà di nuovo attivo.

Telegram's wake-ups come through %1$s.
column2: I risvegli di Telegram arrivano tramite %1$s.

Install a UnifiedPush app like ntfy first.

Tap to pick which UnifiedPush app to use.

column1: # context: Save downloaded files, a switch on the Playback page. It copies each downloaded file or song to the phone's shared Download/Telegram folder.
Save downloaded files
# context: that switch's summary. "Download/Telegram" is a folder path and stays as it is. Chats that don't allow saving are ones whose owner turned on Telegram's content protection.

Each file or song you download also goes to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it. Files from secret chats and chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram.
column2: Ogni file o canzone che scarichi va anche in Download/Telegram sul telefono, dove i gestori di file e altre app possono aprirlo. I file delle chat segrete e delle chat che non consentono il salvataggio restano in Telegram.

column1: # context: a second switch under Save downloaded files (#29). Turned on, it also copies files from chats whose owner turned on Telegram's content protection. Secret chats stay excluded.
Also save from chats that don't allow saving
column2: Salva anche dalle chat che non consentono il salvataggio

column1: # context: that switch's summary, a warning that it goes past the chat owner's choice. "Save downloaded files" is the name of the switch above it.

With Save downloaded files on, files from chats whose owner turned off saving get copied too. Only use it where the owner is fine with you keeping a copy, since it goes past their setting. Secret chats need Also save from secret chats too.
column2: Con Salva i file scaricati attivo, vengono copiati anche i file delle chat in cui il proprietario ha disattivato il salvataggio. Usalo solo quando il proprietario è d'accordo che tu conservi una copia, perché va oltre la sua impostazione. Le chat segrete richiedono anche l'opzione Salva anche dalle chat segrete.

column1: # context: a third switch under Save downloaded files (#9). Turned on, it also copies view-once and self-destructing (timed) photos, videos, voice and video messages. Secret chats stay excluded.
Also save view-once and timed media
column2: Salva anche i media a visualizzazione singola e temporizzati

column1: # context: that switch's summary, a warning that it goes past the sender's choice to have the media disappear. "Save downloaded files" is the name of the first switch.

With Save downloaded files on, view-once and self-destructing photos, videos, voice and video messages get copied to Download/Telegram when they download. The message menu's Save to Downloads shows up on them too. The sender meant them to disappear, so only use it where they're fine with you keeping a copy. Secret chats need Also save from secret chats too.
column2: Con Salva i file scaricati attivo, le foto, i video, i messaggi vocali e i videomessaggi a visualizzazione singola e autodistruttivi vengono copiati in Download/Telegram quando vengono scaricati. Anche Salva nei download compare per questi messaggi nel menu del messaggio. Il mittente voleva che scomparissero, quindi usalo solo quando è d'accordo che tu conservi una copia. Le chat segrete richiedono anche l'opzione Salva anche dalle chat segrete.

column1: # context: a fourth switch under Save downloaded files (#82). Turned on, it also copies files, photos and videos from Telegram secret chats, on top of Also save from chats that don't allow saving. The names in it are the switches above it and the message menu item Save to Downloads.
Also save from secret chats

Works with Also save from chats that don't allow saving on. Files, photos and videos from secret chats get copied too, and the message menu's Save to Downloads shows up there. Their view-once and timed media also need Also save view-once and timed media. A secret chat is meant to stay on your two phones, so only use it where the other person is fine with that.
column2: Funziona con l'opzione Salva anche dalle chat che non consentono il salvataggio attiva. Anche i file, le foto e i video delle chat segrete vengono copiati, e la voce Salva in Download del menu del messaggio compare anche lì. I loro media a visualizzazione singola e temporizzati richiedono anche l'opzione Salva anche i media a visualizzazione singola e temporizzati. Una chat segreta è pensata per restare sui due telefoni, quindi usalo solo quando l'altra persona è d'accordo.

Folders by chat type
# context: that switch's summary. Private, Groups, Channels and Bots are the folder names, use the same words as their own entries.
Turning this on makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders, as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them.

# context: a switch on the Chat list page (#53). It adds a button to Telegram's phone number screen that signs the account in as a bot made with @BotFather, using the bot's token instead of a phone number.
Bot token sign-in
# context: that switch's summary. "Sign in with a bot token" is the button it adds, written here the way that button's own row translates it.

Signing in or adding an account shows a Sign in with a bot token button on the phone number screen. Paste the token from @BotFather to use that account as your bot. A chat shows up once someone messages the bot, without older history, and a bot has no contacts, stickers or folders. A bot with a webhook set, or one another program is reading, may not get its messages here. Turning this off only hides the button.
column2: Quando accedi o aggiungi un account, nella schermata del numero di telefono viene mostrato il pulsante "Accedi con un token bot". Incolla il token di @BotFather per usare quell'account come il tuo bot. Una chat appare quando qualcuno scrive al bot, senza la cronologia precedente, e un bot non ha contatti, sticker o cartelle. Un bot con un webhook impostato, o che un altro programma sta leggendo, potrebbe non ricevere qui i suoi messaggi. Disattivare questa opzione nasconde solo il pulsante.

column1: # context: a switch under Ghost mode (#69). With it on, sending a message in a chat also sends the read receipt Ghost mode held back for that chat.
Read after you reply
# context: that switch's summary. No read receipts is the switch title under Ghost mode, translated the same as that row.
When you send a message in a chat, the read receipt Ghost mode held back there goes out too, so your other devices stop showing it unread. Works with Ghost mode and No read receipts on.
column2: Quando invii un messaggio in una chat, viene inviata anche la conferma di lettura che la Modalità fantasma aveva trattenuto lì, così gli altri tuoi dispositivi non la mostrano più come non letta. Funziona con Modalità fantasma e Nessuna conferma di lettura attive.

column1: # context: a switch under Ghost mode (#69). With it on, a double check button sits at the top of the chat list, next to the ghost.
Read receipts button
# context: that switch's summary. A double check is the two tick marks Telegram shows on a read message.

A double check at the top of the chat list sends the read receipts Ghost mode is holding for the account you're on, from chats read since Telegram last started. Send read receipts in a chat's menu sends just that chat's. Shows with Ghost mode and No read receipts on.
column2: Un doppio segno di spunta in cima alla lista chat invia le conferme di lettura che la Modalità fantasma trattiene per l'account in uso, dalle chat lette dall'ultimo avvio di Telegram. Inviare conferme di lettura nel menu di una chat invia solo quelle di quella chat. Compare con la Modalità fantasma e Nessuna conferma di lettura attive.

column1: # context: Proxy in the chat list menu (#67). A switch on Chat list, off by default: the menu that opens from the top of the chat list (New Group, Saved Messages and so on) always gets Telegram's own Proxy row, which Telegram otherwise shows only while a proxy is on or where Telegram is blocked.
Proxy in the chat list menu
column2: Proxy nel menu della lista chat

column1: The menu at the top of the chat list always has Proxy, so your proxies are one tap away even where Telegram isn't blocked.
column2: Il menu in cima alla lista chat include sempre Proxy, così i tuoi proxy sono a portata di tocco anche dove Telegram non è bloccato.

column1: # context: Free proxies (#66), on Chat list. A switch, off by default, that every 6 hours downloads a public list of MTProto proxies, times a connect to each and puts the 10 fastest in Telegram's own proxy list. A row runs it now and says what the last try found. A second switch, on by default, keeps Telegram's proxy button on the phone number screen before sign-in.
Free proxies

Every 6 hours, downloads a public list of proxies and adds the 10 fastest to Telegram's proxy list, and Telegram connects through them unless you use a proxy of your own. Whoever runs a proxy can see your IP address. Turning this off leaves them in the list.
column2: Ogni 6 ore scarica un elenco pubblico di proxy e aggiunge i 10 più veloci alla lista dei proxy di Telegram, quindi Telegram si connette tramite loro a meno che non usi un proxy tuo. Chi gestisce un proxy può vedere il tuo indirizzo IP. Se disattivi questa opzione, restano nell'elenco.

The chats picked for it get the opposite of Ghost mode: with Ghost mode on they act as in stock Telegram, with it off they keep back what the Ghost mode switches keep back. Online status stays with Ghost mode.
Ghost mode exceptions
# context: that switch's summary. The three dots are the menu Telegram's chat list shows after a long press, where Ghost mode exception sits

The chats you pick work the other way around. While Ghost mode is on they act as usual, and while it's off the Ghost mode switches above apply there. Long press chats in the chat list and use the three dots to add them. Online status follows Ghost mode everywhere.

Quando la Modalità fantasma è attiva si comportano come al solito, e quando è disattivata si applicano gli interruttori della Modalità fantasma qui sopra. Tieni premute le chat nella lista chat e usa i tre puntini per aggiungerle. Lo stato online segue la Modalità fantasma ovunque.

Fake typing
# context: that switch's summary. The status keeps going out every few seconds until ten minutes pass or the chats are picked again
Adds Fake typing to the three dots menu when you long press chats in the chat list. The chats you pick show you typing for 10 minutes, or until you pick them again, even with Ghost mode on.

Instant lock
# context: Summary of Instant lock. Auto-lock is Telegram's own passcode setting; the user's Auto-lock choice is kept and comes back when the switch is off
With a Telegram passcode set, Telegram locks a second or two after you leave it instead of waiting for Auto-lock. Turning this off brings your Auto-lock time back.
column2: Con un codice Telegram impostato, Telegram si blocca un secondo o due dopo che lo lasci invece di attendere il blocco automatico. Disattivando questa opzione ripristina il tempo di blocco automatico.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase naming the Instant lock switch (#71) in the patch status list
instant lock

Don't notify contacts
# context: Summary of Don't notify contacts. It only matters when a new account is created, for example through Add account with a number that has never used Telegram
When you sign up a phone number that's new to Telegram, people who have it saved aren't told you joined. Accounts that already exist aren't affected.
column2: Quando registri un numero di telefono nuovo su Telegram, le persone che lo hanno salvato non vengono avvisate che ti sei iscritto. Gli account già esistenti non sono interessati.

column2: Il menu del profilo di una persona mostra anche il mese approssimativo in cui è entrata su Telegram, calcolato dal suo ID utente. È una stima e non viene chiesto nulla a Telegram. Bot, gruppi e canali non ne hanno.

account registration dates

column1: # context: Second line of a row in a group's member list (#79). %1$s is Telegram's own text there, such as "last seen recently" or "online", and %2$s is the date and time the person joined the group, already written the way the phone writes dates
%1$s · joined %2$s

Show when members joined

A group's member lists, on its profile and its Members page, also show when each person joined, next to their last seen. The date comes with the list, so nothing more is asked of Telegram. Admins and the owner keep their role.
column2: Le liste dei membri di un gruppo, nel suo profilo e nella sua pagina Membri, mostrano anche quando ogni persona è entrata, accanto al suo ultimo accesso. La data arriva con la lista, quindi non viene chiesto nulla di più a Telegram. Gli amministratori e il proprietario mantengono il loro ruolo.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Show user and chat IDs that shows when each person joined a group
member join dates
column2: le date di ingresso dei membri

column1: # context: Switch title on the Chat list page under Hide folder tab counters, off by default (#89). With it on, chat pictures (avatars) in the chat list show at the size picked under Avatar size, a percent of Telegram's own size
Change avatar size
# context: Summary of Change avatar size. The size is picked in the Avatar size row right below it; each chat list row keeps its height and the picture shrinks or grows around its own center
Chat pictures in the chat list show at the size you pick below. Each row keeps its height, and the picture stays centered where Telegram puts it.
column2: Le immagini delle chat nella lista chat vengono mostrate alla dimensione che scegli qui sotto. Ogni riga mantiene la sua altezza e l'immagine resta centrata dove la posiziona Telegram.

column1: # context: Switch title on the Chat list page under Hide folder tab counters, off by default (#103). With it on, tapping Saved Messages in the chat list opens its shared media page instead of the chat. Saved Messages is Telegram's own name for the chat with yourself (key SavedMessages); use its applied translation
Open Saved Messages on its media

# context: Summary of Open Saved Messages on its media (#103). Saved Messages (key SavedMessages), the Chats tab of its media page (key SavedDialogsTab) and the View as Messages menu item (key SavedViewAsMessages) are Telegram's own labels; use their applied translations, or Telegram's English where the language has none (Bulgarian has none for the last two)

Tapping Saved Messages in the chat list opens its shared media page, with your saved chats, media, files, links, music and voice messages. To open the chat itself, tap the menu on the Chats tab and pick View as Messages.
column2: Toccando Messaggi salvati nell'elenco delle chat si apre la pagina dei media condivisi, con le chat salvate, media, file, link, musica e messaggi vocali. Per aprire la chat vera e propria, tocca il menu nella scheda Chat e scegli Mostra come messaggi.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Hide folder tab counters that opens Saved Messages (key SavedMessages) on its shared media page
Saved Messages opening on its media
column2: l'apertura di Messaggi salvati sui media

Avatar size

avatar size in the chat list

Do Not Disturb is on.
# context: Toast after Turn off Do Not Disturb in the chat list menu. Two short lines at most
Do Not Disturb is off.

Do Not Disturb here is HushTelegram's own quiet mode, named like Android's Do Not Disturb (use that name in this language), not Telegram's per-chat mute
Do Not Disturb in the chat list menu
column2: Non disturbare nel menu della lista chat

column1: # context: Summary of Do Not Disturb in the chat list menu. The menu is the one that opens from the top of the chat list; a message notification is the one Telegram posts for a new message; calls still ring
Adds Do Not Disturb to the menu at the top of the chat list. While it's on, no message notification shows or makes a sound, and messages still arrive. Calls ring as usual.
column2: Aggiunge Non disturbare al menu in cima alla lista chat. Quando è attivo, non appare né suona alcuna notifica di messaggio, e i messaggi continuano ad arrivare. Le chiamate squillano come al solito.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the Do Not Disturb item that Proxy in the chat list menu adds to the menu at the top of the chat list. Do Not Disturb here is HushTelegram's own quiet mode, named like Android's Do Not Disturb (use that name in this language), not Telegram's per-chat mute
Do Not Disturb menu item
column2: la voce Non disturbare del menu

column1: # context: Privacy page switch under Draft link previews. It makes the preview of a link you send come from another site, the way the rules in Link preview rules say
Fix link previews
# context: Line under the Fix link previews switch. fixupx.com and x.com are web sites and stay as they are
When you send a link to a site in your rules, its preview comes from the other site the rule names, like fixupx.com for x.com. Your message keeps the link you typed.
column2: Quando invii un link a un sito presente nelle tue regole, la sua anteprima proviene dall'altro sito indicato dalla regola, come fixupx.com per x.com. Il tuo messaggio mantiene il link che hai digitato.

column1: # context: Privacy page row title under the Fix link previews switch, the title of its editor dialog, and a label in the settings import preview line "%1$s: %2$s to %3$s"
Link preview rules
column2: Regole per le anteprime dei link

column1: # context: Summary of the Link preview rules row when it holds no rules. x.com -> fixupx.com is a rule as typed and stays as it is
No rules yet. Add one per line, like x.com/*/status -> fixupx.com.
column2: Ancora nessuna regola. Aggiungine una per riga, come x.com/*/status -> fixupx.com.

column1: # context: Summary of the Link preview rules row with the number of rules. Fix link previews is the name of the switch above it
Rules: %1$s. Fix link previews follows these for the links you send.
column2: Regole: %1$s. Correggi anteprime dei link le segue per i link che invii.

column1: # context: Hint and label of the box in the Link preview rules dialog, where each line is one rule. x.com -> fixupx.com stays as it is
One rule per line, like x.com/*/status -> fixupx.com
column2: Una regola per riga, come x.com/*/status -> fixupx.com

column1: # context: Note in the Link preview rules dialog. The arrow is the -> typed between two sites; *. and the sites stay as they are

Each line is a site, an arrow and the site its previews come from. Put *. in front of both to cover subdomains too, like *.tiktok.com -> *.kktiktok.com. A path after the first site covers only links that start with it, * standing for any one part, like x.com/*/status -> fixupx.com. Lines that aren't rules are left out.
column2: Ogni riga è un sito, una freccia e il sito da cui provengono le anteprime. Metti *. davanti a entrambi per includere anche i sottodomini, come *.tiktok.com -> *.kktiktok.com. Un percorso dopo il primo sito copre solo i link che iniziano con esso, dove * indica una qualsiasi parte, come x.com/*/status -> fixupx.com. Le righe che non sono regole vengono ignorate.

column1: # context: Button in the Link preview rules dialog, next to Save and Cancel. It puts the starting rules back in the box. Short
Default rules

column2: Troppe regole da conservare. Rimuovine alcune.

Lines left out: %1$s. They aren't rules.
# context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Draft link previews that points a sent link's preview at another site
link preview rules
column2: le regole per le anteprime dei link

# context: Playback page switch under Save downloaded files. It gives APK and EXE files their own icon and shows a downloaded PDF's first page or a video's frame as the file's picture
File icons and thumbnails
# context: Line under the File icons and thumbnails switch. APK, EXE and PDF are file types and stay as they are. Shared media is the page of a chat's photos, files and links
APK and EXE files get their own icon in chats and in Shared media. Once downloaded, a PDF shows its first page and a video a frame from it. Files with a thumbnail from Telegram keep it.
column2: I file APK e EXE ricevono un'icona propria nelle chat e nei Media condivisi. Una volta scaricati, un PDF mostra la sua prima pagina e un video un fotogramma. I file con una miniatura di Telegram la mantengono.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Save downloaded files that draws file icons in chat bubbles
file icons and thumbnails in chats
column2: le icone e le miniature dei file nelle chat

file icons and thumbnails in Shared media
column2: le icone e le miniature dei file nei Media condivisi

column1: # context: Playback page switch under Save downloaded files, off by default (#79). With it on, a file Telegram already has on the phone shows as downloaded instead of with a download button.
Recognize files you already have
column2: Riconosci i file che hai già

column1: # context: Line under the Recognize files you already have switch. Keep Telegram's files in internal storage is the name of another switch on the same page, so use its translation.

A file Telegram already downloaded, in another account for example, shows as downloaded here too when its folders hold one with the same name and size. With Keep Telegram's files in internal storage on, files from before a reinstall count too.
column2: Un file che Telegram ha già scaricato, per esempio in un altro account, viene mostrato come scaricato anche qui quando le cartelle di Telegram ne contengono uno con lo stesso nome e dimensione. Con Mantieni i file di Telegram nella memoria interna attivo, contano anche i file precedenti a una reinstallazione.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Save downloaded files that shows files already on the phone as downloaded.
how files you already have show up
column2: come vengono mostrati i file che hai già

Picture behind the lists
# context: Summary of Picture behind the lists. Settings is Telegram's own Settings screen; built-in themes are the ones Telegram ships (Day, Classic, Night, Dark), not a theme installed from a file.
Shows a picture from your gallery behind the chat list, Settings, profiles and the other lists. Chats keep their wallpaper, and menus and dialogs stay solid. Works with Telegram's built-in themes.
column2: Mostra un'immagine dalla tua galleria dietro la lista chat, Impostazioni, i profili e le altre liste. Le chat mantengono il loro sfondo e i menu e i dialoghi restano opachi. Funziona con i temi integrati di Telegram.

forward dates

column2: Un gruppo o un canale che possiedi o amministri riceve Strumenti di amministrazione nel menu in alto. Apre Azioni recenti, gli elenchi dei membri e Link d'invito, nei limiti dei tuoi permessi.

Members

Subscribers

Permissions

Invite Links

Admin

Admin folder
# context: Summary of the Admin folder switch. Admin is the folder's name
Turning this on makes an Admin folder with the groups and channels you own or manage, and keeps it up to date as that changes. Turning it off removes it, unless you renamed or changed it.
column2: Attivandolo viene creata una cartella Admin con i gruppi e i canali che possiedi o amministri, e viene mantenuta aggiornata man mano che cambia. Disattivandolo viene rimossa, a meno che tu non l'abbia rinominata o modificata.

column1: # context: Toast when the Admin folder switch is turned on but the user owns or manages no group or channel; the switch goes back off
You don't manage any groups or channels yet.
column2: Non possiedi né amministri ancora gruppi o canali.

column1: # context: Toast after Telegram made the Admin folder
Made the Admin folder.
# context: Toast after Telegram made the Admin folder when the user manages more chats than a folder can hold
Made the Admin folder. Some chats didn't fit.
column2: Cartella Admin creata. Alcune chat non ci sono entrate.

column1: # context: Toast after the Admin folder switch was turned off and Telegram removed the folder
Removed the Admin folder.
# context: Toast when the Admin folder switch is turned off but the user renamed or edited the folder, so it isn't removed
You changed the Admin folder, so it stays.
column2: Hai modificato la cartella Admin, quindi rimane.

column1: # context: Toast when Telegram refused to make the Admin folder; the switch goes back off
Telegram didn't make the folder. Try again later.
column2: Telegram non ha creato la cartella. Riprova più tardi.

column1: # context: Toast when Telegram refused to remove the Admin folder; the switch goes back on
Telegram kept the Admin folder. Try again later.
column2: Telegram ha mantenuto la cartella Admin. Riprova più tardi.

admin tools in a chat's menu
column2: gli strumenti di amministrazione nel menu di una chat

the Admin folder

Man

the voice changer
# context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names Edit a copy in the message menu, which opens a chat photo in Telegram's photo editor
editing a copy of a photo
column2: la modifica di una copia di una foto

column1: # context: Item in a photo message's long-press menu. It opens a copy of the photo in Telegram's photo editor, and sending it sends the edited copy to the chat
Edit a copy
# context: Switch title in HushTelegram settings that adds Edit a copy to a photo message's long-press menu
Add Edit a copy to the message menu
column2: Aggiungi Modifica una copia al menu del messaggio

column1: # context: Summary under the Edit a copy switch in HushTelegram settings
Opens a photo from a chat in Telegram's photo editor, where you can draw, add text or blur parts. Sending it sends the edited copy to the chat. The photo in the chat stays as it was.
column2: Apre una foto di una chat nell'editor di foto di Telegram, dove puoi disegnare, aggiungere testo o sfocare parti. Inviandola, invia la copia modificata alla chat. La foto nella chat resta com'era.

column1: # context: Switch title in HushTelegram settings that adds Send photo to the menu of the link preview above the message box
Add Send photo to the link preview menu
column2: Aggiungi Invia foto al menu dell'anteprima del link

column1: # context: Summary under the Send photo switch for the link preview menu in HushTelegram settings

When the link preview above the message box has a picture, its menu gets Send photo. The picture goes to the chat with what you typed as its caption, and the preview is removed. Text too long for a caption stays in the box.
column2: Quando l'anteprima del link sopra la casella del messaggio ha un'immagine, il suo menu mostra Invia foto. L'immagine va nella chat con quello che hai scritto come didascalia e l'anteprima viene rimossa. Il testo troppo lungo per una didascalia resta nella casella.

column1: # context: Row in the menu of the link preview above the message box, beside Telegram's Apply changes and Do not preview. It sends the preview's picture to the chat
Send photo
# context: Short toast when the link preview's picture can't be downloaded after tapping Send photo
Couldn't get the photo. Try again.
# context: Short toast when the link preview's picture can't be sent after tapping Send photo
Couldn't send the photo. Try again.
# context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names Send photo in the link preview menu.
sending a link preview's photo
column2: l'invio della foto di un'anteprima del link

column1: # context: Title of the Duress passcode switch (#79) on HushTelegram's Privacy page, also the first field's hint in its dialog. A duress passcode is a second passcode someone types when forced to unlock; typing it logs every account out
Duress passcode

# context: Summary of the Duress passcode switch. It must say plainly that typing the code logs out or deletes accounts, as picked in the row below it, that HushTelegram's kept data is cleared, and that the switch starts off

Typing the duress passcode on Telegram's lock screen logs out or deletes accounts, as picked below, and clears what HushTelegram kept, like deleted messages, edit history and call recordings. It needs a Telegram passcode and starts off.
column2: Digitando il codice di emergenza nella schermata di blocco di Telegram si esce dagli account o li elimina, come scelto sotto, e si cancellano i dati conservati da HushTelegram, come messaggi eliminati, cronologia delle modifiche e registrazioni delle chiamate. Richiede un codice di Telegram e all'inizio è disattivato.

column1: # context: Title of the row under the Duress passcode switch that opens a dialog to pick the code, also that dialog's title
Set duress passcode
# context: Summary of the Set duress passcode row while no duress passcode is saved
No duress passcode yet. Tap to pick one.
column2: Ancora nessun codice di emergenza. Tocca per sceglierne uno.

column1: # context: Summary of the Set duress passcode row once a duress passcode is saved. The code itself is never shown
A duress passcode is set. Tap to change it.
column2: È impostato un codice di emergenza. Tocca per cambiarlo.

column1: # context: Message at the top of the Set duress passcode dialog, above its two fields
Typing this on Telegram's lock screen logs out every account on this phone. Pick one that's different from your Telegram passcode.
column2: Digitando questo codice nella schermata di blocco di Telegram si esce da tutti gli account su questo telefono. Scegline uno diverso dal tuo codice di Telegram.

column1: # context: Message at the top of the Set duress passcode dialog when Log out the open account is picked
Typing this on Telegram's lock screen logs out the open account. Pick one that's different from your Telegram passcode.
column2: Digitando questo codice nella schermata di blocco di Telegram si esce dall'account aperto. Scegline uno diverso dal tuo codice di Telegram.

column1: # context: Message at the top of the Set duress passcode dialog when Delete every account is picked
Typing this twice on Telegram's lock screen deletes every account on this phone for good. Pick one that's different from your Telegram passcode.
column2: Digitando due volte questo codice nella schermata di blocco di Telegram si eliminano definitivamente tutti gli account su questo telefono. Scegline uno diverso dal tuo codice di Telegram.

column1: # context: Message at the top of the Set duress passcode dialog when Delete the open account is picked
Typing this twice on Telegram's lock screen deletes the open account for good. Pick one that's different from your Telegram passcode.
column2: Digitando due volte questo codice nella schermata di blocco di Telegram si elimina definitivamente l'account aperto. Scegline uno diverso dal tuo codice di Telegram.

column1: # context: Hint of the second field in the Set duress passcode dialog, where the code is typed again to confirm it
Type it again
# context: Refusal in the Set duress passcode dialog when the two fields differ
The two passcodes don't match.
# context: Toast once a duress passcode is saved
Duress passcode saved.
# context: Refusal in the Set duress passcode dialog when the first field is empty
Type a duress passcode.
# context: Refusal in the Set duress passcode dialog when Telegram's passcode is a 4-digit PIN and the code isn't 4 digits. Telegram's lock screen takes exactly 4 digits
Use 4 digits, the same length as your Telegram passcode.
column2: Usa 4 cifre, la stessa lunghezza del tuo codice di Telegram.

column1: # context: Refusal in the Set duress passcode dialog when the code typed is the user's real Telegram passcode
That's your Telegram passcode. Pick a different one.
column2: È il tuo codice di Telegram. Scegline uno diverso.

column1: # context: Title of the row under Set duress passcode (#79) that opens a single-choice dialog of what typing the duress passcode does, also that dialog's title
What the duress passcode does
column2: Cosa fa il codice di emergenza

column1: # context: Choice in the What the duress passcode does dialog, also the row's summary: logs out every account on the phone. The default
Log out every account
# context: Choice in the What the duress passcode does dialog, also the row's summary: logs out only the account open in Telegram right now, the other accounts stay signed in
Log out the open account
# context: Choice in the What the duress passcode does dialog, also the row's summary: permanently deletes every Telegram account on the phone
Delete every account
# context: Choice in the What the duress passcode does dialog, also the row's summary: permanently deletes only the account open in Telegram right now
Delete the open account

# context: Second line of the summary of the What the duress passcode does row (#79), shown while a deleting choice is picked. The first time the code is typed the lock screen acts as if it was wrong, the second time the accounts are deleted for good. Telegram waits a week before deleting an account that has a cloud password (two-step verification)
Typed once, the duress passcode looks wrong. Typed again, it deletes for good. If an account has a cloud password, Telegram waits a week first.
column2: Digitato una volta, il codice di emergenza sembra sbagliato. Digitato di nuovo, elimina definitivamente. Se un account ha una password cloud, Telegram aspetta prima una settimana.

column1: # context: Short warning toast (#79) when a deleting choice is picked, or the Duress passcode switch turns on with one picked: typing the duress passcode twice deletes the accounts for good. Must fit two toast lines of 28 characters
Typed twice, the duress passcode deletes for good.
column2: Digitato due volte, elimina per sempre.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase naming the Duress passcode switch (#79) in the patch status list
duress passcode

# context: Title of a switch under Free proxies on the Chat list page, and the feature's name in Export settings and the patch status list. V2Ray is a proxy tool; VMess, VLESS, Trojan and Shadowsocks are its kinds of servers
V2Ray-style servers
# context: Summary under the V2Ray-style servers switch. The proxy runs inside the app on the phone; Telegram's proxy list is Telegram's own Proxy Settings list

Telegram connects through your own VMess, VLESS, Trojan and Shadowsocks servers by way of a proxy that runs inside Telegram, with one entry for it in Telegram's proxy list. It's used unless you use a proxy of your own. Calls don't go through it.
column2: Telegram si connette attraverso i tuoi server VMess, VLESS, Trojan e Shadowsocks per mezzo di un proxy che gira dentro Telegram, con una voce per esso nell'elenco dei proxy di Telegram. Viene usato salvo che tu usi un proxy tuo. Le chiamate non passano da lì.

column1: # context: Title of a row under V2Ray-style servers and of its dialog, where the person pastes links to their own servers
Your V2Ray links
# context: Summary of the Your V2Ray links row when nothing is pasted yet. Your proxy lists is another row on the same page, use its translated title
Paste vmess://, vless://, trojan:// and ss:// links here. Links in Your proxy lists are read too.
column2: Incolla qui link vmess://, vless://, trojan:// e ss://. Vengono letti anche i link in Le tue liste di proxy.

column1: # context: Summary of the Your V2Ray links row: how many links are saved. Your proxy lists is another row on the same page
Links saved: %1$s. Links in Your proxy lists are read too.
column2: Link salvati: %1$s. Vengono letti anche i link in Le tue liste di proxy.

column1: # context: Hint in the empty box of the Your V2Ray links dialog
One link a line
# context: Note under the box in the Your V2Ray links dialog. TCP, WebSocket and TLS are network protocol names
VMess, VLESS, Trojan and Shadowsocks links work, over TCP or WebSocket, with or without TLS. They stay on this phone and out of settings files.
column2: I link VMess, VLESS, Trojan e Shadowsocks funzionano su TCP o WebSocket, con o senza TLS. Restano su questo telefono e fuori dai file delle impostazioni.

column1: # context: Short toast and note in the Your V2Ray links dialog when a line isn't a link it reads; the number is the line's number
Line %1$s isn't a link this can use
column2: La riga %1$s non è un link utilizzabile

column1: # context: Short toast and note in the Your V2Ray links dialog when too many links are pasted
Up to %1$s links
# context: Short toast when the pasted V2Ray links couldn't be saved, at most two short lines
Couldn't save the links. Try again in a moment.
column2: Impossibile salvare i link. Riprova tra poco.

column1: # context: Title of a row under V2Ray-style servers and of its picker, which picks the server Telegram goes through
V2Ray server
# context: First choice in the V2Ray server picker: no fixed server, the fastest one that answered the last test
The fastest that answers
# context: A server in the V2Ray server picker: its name, then how many milliseconds it took to answer
# context: A server in the V2Ray server picker that didn't answer the last test: its name, then that
%1$s, no answer
# context: Name in the V2Ray server picker for a server whose link has no name, with its place in the list
Server %1$s
# context: Button in the V2Ray server picker that times every server again
Test again
# context: Summary of the V2Ray server row when the proxy inside Telegram couldn't start. The switch is V2Ray-style servers, just above
The local proxy couldn't start. Turn the switch off and on again.
column2: Il proxy locale non è riuscito ad avviarsi. Spegni e riaccendi l'interruttore.

column1: # context: Summary of the V2Ray server row while every server is being timed
Testing your V2Ray-style servers now.
column2: Test dei tuoi server in stile V2Ray in corso.

column1: # context: Summary of the V2Ray server row before the first test
Not tested yet. Tap to pick a server or test them now.
column2: Non ancora provati. Tocca per scegliere un server o provali ora.

column1: # context: Summary of the V2Ray server row when the last test found no link it can use in the pasted links or the person's own proxy lists
No V2Ray-style links found in your links or proxy lists.
column2: Nessun link in stile V2Ray trovato nei tuoi link o nelle tue liste di proxy.

column1: # context: Summary of the V2Ray server row when no server answered the last test
None of your servers answered last time.
column2: Nessuno dei tuoi server ha risposto l'ultima volta.

Servers that answered last time: %1$s of %2$s.
column2: Server che hanno risposto l'ultima volta: %1$s su %2$s.
