Skipped, not supported yet: %1$s.
# context: Added to the V2Ray server row's summary: the server the person picked, by its name
Using %1$s.
# context: Item in the list of skipped link kinds on the V2Ray server row: links that send fake HTTP headers over TCP
TCP with HTTP headers
# context: Item in the list of skipped link kinds on the V2Ray server row: Shadowsocks links that need a plugin
Shadowsocks plugins
# context: Item in the list of skipped link kinds on the V2Ray server row: Shadowsocks links with a cipher it can't use
other Shadowsocks ciphers
# context: Item in the list of skipped link kinds on the V2Ray server row: VLESS links that ask for VLESS's own encryption
VLESS encryption
# context: read aloud after a settings row's name when a dot marks it as added since the settings were last opened
New
# context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names one part of a patch that couldn't go in on this Telegram version.
view-once and timed media shown unblurred
column2: i media a visualizzazione singola e a tempo mostrati senza sfocatura

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names one part of a patch that couldn't go in on this Telegram version.
screenshots of view-once and timed media
column2: gli screenshot dei media a visualizzazione singola e a tempo

column1: # context: Title of the box that asks for an API ID and hash, and the button on the sign-in refusal that opens it. The two sign-in messages below name this button.
Enter your API ID
# context: App api_id and App api_hash are the labels on my.telegram.org/apps, which is in English only, so they stay as they are.
Type App api_id and App api_hash from my.telegram.org/apps. They stay on this phone, and Telegram restarts to sign in with them.
column2: Scrivi App api_id e App api_hash da my.telegram.org/apps. Restano su questo telefono, e Telegram si riavvia per accedere con questi dati.

column1: # context: Field label, kept in English: the label on my.telegram.org/apps.
App api_id
# context: Field label, kept in English: the label on my.telegram.org/apps.
App api_hash
# context: Toast and the line under the field when the API ID isn't a number.
An API ID is only digits, like 1234567.
column2: Un ID API è fatto solo di cifre, come 1234567.

column1: # context: Toast and the line under the field when the API hash isn't 32 hex characters.
An API hash is 32 letters and numbers.
column2: Un hash API ha 32 lettere e numeri.

column1: # context: Toast after Save, right before the app restarts.
Saved. Telegram restarts now.
# context: Toast after Remove, right before the app restarts.
Removed. Telegram restarts now.
# context: Sign-in refusal for API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD. Names the Enter your API ID button by its translated label.

Telegram turned down the API ID this app signs in with, so no login code was sent. Register your own app at my.telegram.org/apps, then tap Enter your API ID and type its App api_id and App api_hash. The guide walks you through it.
column2: Telegram ha rifiutato l'ID API con cui questa app accede, quindi non è stato inviato alcun codice di accesso. Registra una tua app su my.telegram.org/apps, poi tocca Inserisci il tuo ID API e scrivi i suoi App api_id e App api_hash. La guida ti spiega come fare.

column1: # context: Sign-in refusal for API_ID_INVALID. Names the Enter your API ID button by its translated label.
Telegram didn't accept the API ID and hash this app signs in with, so no login code was sent. Copy both again from my.telegram.org/apps and tap Enter your API ID.
column2: Telegram non ha accettato l'ID API e l'hash con cui questa app accede, quindi non è stato inviato alcun codice di accesso. Copia di nuovo entrambi da my.telegram.org/apps e tocca Inserisci il tuo ID API.

column1: # context: Chat list page switch title, under Hide Contacts tab. When on, the Downloads button in the top bar of the chat list (Telegram key DownloadsTabs; use its applied translation) no longer shows.
Hide Downloads button
# context: that switch's summary. Downloads is the button (Telegram key DownloadsTabs) and also the tab with the same name in the chat list's search; use its applied translation for both.
The Downloads button stays out of the bar at the top of the chat list, even while a file downloads. Your downloads are still in the Downloads tab when you search.
column2: Il pulsante Download non compare più nella barra in alto della lista chat, nemmeno mentre si scarica un file. I tuoi download restano nella scheda Download quando cerchi.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase in a status line. It names the part of Hide Contacts tab that hides the Downloads button (Telegram key DownloadsTabs) in the chat list's top bar.
Downloads button

# context: Chat list page switch title, under Hide Downloads button. When on, the Downloads button in the top bar of the chat list (Telegram key DownloadsTabs; use its applied translation) shows even when nothing downloads.
Always show Downloads button

# context: that switch's summary. Downloads is the button (Telegram key DownloadsTabs; use its applied translation). Hide Downloads button is the switch of that name, which overrules this one; use its translation from this table.
The Downloads button stays in the bar at the top of the chat list even when nothing is downloading, so your downloads are one tap away. Hide Downloads button wins.
column2: Il pulsante Download resta nella barra in alto della lista chat anche quando non si sta scaricando niente, così i tuoi download sono a un tocco. Nascondi il pulsante Download ha la precedenza.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase filling %1$s or %2$s in "This patched app changes %1$s but not %2$s." It names the part of Hide Contacts tab that keeps the Downloads button (Telegram key DownloadsTabs) in the chat list's top bar all the time.
showing the Downloads button all the time
# context: Look and feel page switch title, under Change sticker size. When on, Telegram's automatic cache cleanup no longer deletes sticker files, so sticker packs don't download again.
Keep downloaded stickers
# context: that switch's summary. The cleanup is the one Telegram runs by itself (Keep media and the cache size limit); clearing the cache by hand is the person's own action.
Telegram's automatic cache cleanup leaves sticker files alone, so sticker packs you've used don't download again. Clearing the cache yourself still removes them.
column2: La pulizia automatica della cache di Telegram lascia stare i file degli sticker, così i pacchetti che hai usato non vengono scaricati di nuovo. Se svuoti la cache tu, vengono comunque rimossi.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase in a status line. It names the part of Change sticker size that keeps sticker files through Telegram's automatic cache cleanup.
sticker files kept through cache cleanup
column2: file degli sticker conservati nella pulizia della cache

column1: # context: Look and feel page row title and its dialog's title, under Change sticker size. It picks how big stickers show in the sticker panel below the message box, where you pick a sticker to send, and in that panel's search.
Sticker panel size
# context: A choice in the Sticker panel size dialog and the row's summary: the panel as Telegram ships it.
Telegram's size
# context: A choice in the Sticker panel size dialog: bigger stickers than Telegram's, fewer to a row.
Large
# context: A choice in the Sticker panel size dialog: bigger again than Large.
Larger
# context: The Sticker panel size row's summary. %1$s is the size picked: Telegram's size, Large or Larger.
%1$s. A bigger size shows fewer, bigger stickers in the sticker panel and its search. A chat picks this up the next time you open it.
column2: %1$s. Una dimensione maggiore mostra meno sticker, ma più grandi, nel pannello degli sticker e nella sua ricerca. Una chat la applica la prossima volta che la apri.

column1: # context: Lowercase noun phrase in a status line. It names the part of Change sticker size that sets how big stickers show in the sticker panel.
sticker size in the sticker panel
column2: dimensione degli sticker nel pannello degli sticker
